items.title: A finite free cover of the pushforward of a one step devissage with a strictly smaller cokernel on the fibre
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces an explicit finite free presentation alpha : O_Y^{\oplus r} -> pi_*G that is an isomorphism at the generic point xi of Y_s and, more importantly, forces the cokernel on the fibre to have strictly smaller support than F_s (statement lines 1144-1158). The non-routine part is the dimension bookkeeping: the vanishing N' tensor kappa(p) = 0 obtained from the isomorphism at xi must be converted into N'_p = 0 by Nakayama, and the strict inequality then follows only because the fibre Y_s is geometrically irreducible of dimension n with generic point xi, so that dropping the generic point really lowers the dimension (proof lines 1175-1182). The construction of alpha itself is a plain lift of a basis of a residue-field fibre, so the claim sits at H2 rather than H3.
